Beta customers can search the full catalog with typo tolerance.
Search v2 serves all production traffic.

Admins can invite their team from the setup flow.
The setup flow ships in three languages.
Admins can export any report as CSV.
Each user receives at most one digest email per day.
Usage and retention dashboards are live for every workspace.
The app works through a full day offline without losing data.
Push notifications reach iOS and Android devices.
Every product surface uses the shared color and type tokens.
Forms and buttons come from the component library.

issues.title: Switch reads to the new ledger

seededComments.body: Drift shows up on about 0.3% of invoices in staging, always a payment that lands between the two writes. We need the reconciler before the cutover, not after.
Agreed. I can pair on it once payments dual-write is in review.
This also holds up Beacon's typo tolerance (ENG-23 waits on it). Who can pick it up this week?
Typo tolerance works on our side; results disagree between the ledgers when amounts are rounded, so this waits on the drift fix in ENG-12.
The sample data should include one project with milestones so the checklist has something to show.
Repro: cold start on Android 14 with an empty offline queue. The crash report has the stack trace.
Token exchange works end to end; refresh rotation still needs tests.
Should the header names follow the common `x-ratelimit-*` style? Leaning yes, people know it.
Colour tokens and the type scale wait on each other: tokens need the ramp for line heights, the ramp needs tokens for contrast. Proposal: freeze the ramp first.
Happy to freeze the ramp this week if the tokens can follow next week.
The vendor wants the signed PO a week before renewal.
Asked two vendors for a site survey; first quote expected Friday.

iss-eng-1.description:
Model invoices, payments and adjustments as append-only ledger entries.

- One row per money movement
- Balances are derived, never stored
- Every entry carries the source system and a correlation id

iss-eng-2.description: Move the invoices table onto the new ledger schema. Keep the old table readable until the read path switches.

iss-eng-3.description: Canceled: history stays in the legacy ledger and is read through the compatibility view.

iss-eng-10.description:
Write every invoice to both ledgers behind the `ledger_dual_write` flag.

**Acceptance**
- Writes to both ledgers commit together or not at all
- Latency stays within 10% of today

iss-eng-11.description: Same as invoices, for payments. Refunds are payments with a negative amount.

iss-eng-12.description:
Staging shows the two ledgers disagreeing on a small share of invoices. Find the cause and add a nightly reconciler that reports (and can repair) drift.

1. Reproduce with the staging replay
2. Write the reconciler
3. Alert when drift is above zero for two nights

iss-eng-13.description: A per-workspace flag so dual-write can be turned on gradually and off instantly.

iss-eng-14.description: Duplicate of the audit logging that ENG-11 already covers.

iss-eng-16.description: Compare every read served by the new ledger with the legacy answer and log mismatches.

iss-eng-17.description: Switch reads to the new ledger once parity checks have been green for a week.

iss-eng-18.description: Drop the legacy ledger tables and the compatibility view after the read path switch.

iss-eng-20.description: Index products, variants and categories. Full rebuild under 10 minutes.

iss-eng-21.description: Parse quoted phrases, minus terms and field filters (`brand:`).

iss-eng-22.description: Blend text relevance with popularity; keep the old ranking behind a flag for comparison.

iss-eng-23.description: Match queries with one or two typos ("headphnes" finds headphones). Beta customers asked for this first.

iss-eng-24.description: Send query, result count and click position events so we can measure search quality.

iss-eng-25.description: A small "Was this helpful?" widget under the results, beta workspaces only.

iss-eng-26.description: Spacing, empty state and keyboard navigation on the results page.

iss-eng-30.description: The checklist new workspaces see on first sign-in: create a project, invite a teammate, connect an integration.

iss-eng-31.description: Offer a sample project (with milestones) so the checklist has something to show.

iss-eng-32.description: Three starter templates: product launch, bug triage, hiring.

iss-eng-33.description: From two sales calls: prospects want SAML SSO configured during onboarding, not after.

iss-eng-34.description: Track each checklist step so we can see where new workspaces stop.

iss-eng-35.description: Invite by email or link from the setup flow; admins approve link joins.

iss-eng-36.description: Extract the setup copy into message files and send them for translation.

iss-eng-40.description: One email per user per day listing what changed in their projects.

iss-eng-41.description: Send digests at 8:00 in each user's timezone; skip days with nothing to say.

iss-eng-50.description: Queue writes made offline and replay them in order when the device reconnects.

iss-eng-51.description: Last writer wins per field; a conflicting delete wins over an edit.

iss-eng-52.description: Show "Offline · 3 changes waiting" in the header while the queue is not empty.

iss-eng-54.description:
The app crashes on cold start when the offline queue is empty (Android 14).

**Steps**
1. Clear app data
2. Sign in, force-quit
3. Open the app again

iss-eng-60.description: OAuth 2 token exchange and refresh for the v3 API, with rotating refresh tokens.

iss-eng-61.description: Return remaining requests and the reset time on every v3 response.

iss-eng-62.description: Reference pages generated from the v3 schema, with one example per endpoint.

iss-eng-63.description: Email owners of v2 keys, then stop issuing new v2 keys.

iss-eng-70.description: Named colour tokens for surfaces, text and borders, light and dark.

iss-eng-71.description: A type ramp of six sizes with line heights that fit the 4px grid.

iss-eng-72.description: Primary, secondary and quiet buttons with loading and disabled states.

iss-eng-73.description: Text field, select, checkbox and radio, all labelled and keyboard friendly.

iss-eng-80.description: Bring the on-call runbook up to date with the new alerting setup.

iss-ops-1.description: Three emails over the first week: welcome, first project, invite your team.

iss-ops-2.description: Check every translated setup screen on a phone and a laptop.

iss-ops-5.description: A background job that writes the export to storage and emails a link.

iss-ops-6.description: Only admins and report owners can export; every export is logged.

iss-ops-8.description: Daily active users and actions per workspace for the last 90 days.

iss-ops-30.description: The monitoring contract renews at the end of the month; get the quote approved and the PO signed.
